replication_status: exact (Stata csdid on the shipped data reproduces the printed -0.431 and N 19,432; R hand implementation of the pair-balanced cells with csdid's cell-count weights gives -0.4310009045, scratchpad/meta4/csdid_hand.R)
notes: Callawaytest2.dta: 21,152 firm-quarters, 3,708 firms, qofd 129-142 (14 quarters), unbalanced. gvar = first EDGAR quarter (134, 135, 138, 139, 141, 142, 143; 0 = never), one value per firm. gvar 143 lies after the last sample quarter (142): csdid keeps it as a cohort with pre-periods only, so those 42 firms serve only as not-yet-treated controls; run_spec.R maps them to never-treated, which is the same control set. Never-treated: 1,763 firms. No always-treated firms. The paper reports a CSA estimate here, not a TWFE; authors_rerun_twfe_raw is the static TWFE (fixest, firm + quarter FE, cluster firm) on this same file, -0.3643 (0.1235), SD icc 6.51666. AUTHORS' CSA SETTINGS (PROTOCOL 5b Hull alignment (c)): not-yet-treated controls (pipeline default), no covariates (dripw = difference of means), simple aggregation, and csdid's pair-balanced cells on the unbalanced panel: each (g,t) cell uses only firms observed in both g-1 and t (N 19,432 of 21,152 rows enter some cell), and the simple ATT weights each post cell by the number of cohort-g firms in that cell (n_gt varies with t); weighting the same cells by cohort size gives -0.44399, so the weights matter. Hence csa_cells = 'pairs'. spec_id keeps 'T11' (screening id); the article location is Table 12 col 2 (the do-file comment and the earlier log said Table 11 Panel B). Superseded: the earlier published_coef -0.3864 was an R did approximation made when csdid was not installed.
